items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I was broke with Hot Lips Page. We were always in the red... So the whole band, we happened to go into a roadhouse...

ctx.x: Why were you broke with Charlie Barnet?

No, I was broke with Hot Lips Page. We were always in the red. I don't know, Lips would let his money get out of hand... He had a lot of friends in Chicago, and instead of taking the bus that the (?) office volunteered for us, he would take the money and divide it with his friends, and have cars to take us from Chicago to Cedar Rapids, Iowa! That's a long ways to go for a one-nighter. And all the tires blew out on the road, we had to... So the whole band, we happened to go into a roadhouse and pass the hat around…
How big a band did Lips have then?
